source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第六节

textbook_summary: Broad polymorphic QRS dominant direction twists about baseline every 3 to 10 beats; typical TdP also has antecedent long QT and transient episodes.

authored_choices.second_limb_basis: (LL-LA, RA-LL, LA-RA) * 577/1000 for RA, LA, LL; RL zero
authored_choices.second_chest_basis: Wilson-relative paired C1/C4, C2/C5, C3/C6 quadrature

invariants: Four-beat reversal and eight-beat repetition preserve ventricular ordinal across recovery
Two independent bases avoid simultaneous loss of all QRS projections at intermediate rotation
Shared electrode projections retain limb identities; combined monitorII has17 bands
Fixed electrical/mechanical timing and non-ECG inputs do not vary with electrical sign
Both demos reject orphan twisting and combinations with bidirectional/fusion/capture
limitations: Morphology illustration only, NOT a complete TdP model
QT275ms is ventricular component support, not an antecedent long-QT rhythm
No episodic onset/termination/recurrence, degeneration to VF or TdP hemodynamic feedback
Authored bases/weights and secondary T changes, not anatomical propagation or clinical calibration
